# 🔥 Hyper Fetch Firebase

Type-safe Firebase/Firestore client built on HyperFetch. CRUD, realtime listeners, auth — all typed.

## 📖 About This adapter brings HyperFetch's typed request system to Firebase. Use the same

patterns for
Firestore and Realtime Database operations with typed responses, caching, queuing, and React hooks — the same API you
use for REST.

## 🎯 Key Capabilities

- 🔥 **Same API for Firebase** — Use

for Firestore and Realtime Database, just like REST
- 🔮 **Typed CRUD** —

with full TypeScript types on every field
- 📡 **Realtime subscriptions** — Listen to document and collection changes with typed data flowing in
- ⚛️ **React hooks for Firebase** —

work with Firebase operations — same patterns, different
  backend
- 💾 **Cache and offline support** — HyperFetch's caching and offline queue work with Firebase out of the box
